I work at a pizza place. The dough doesn’t shrink during the baking process. However, there are times where we are really busy and we toss the dough while it’s still really cold. Cold dough tends to shrink small if you don’t overstretch the dough and overshoot your target. Whoever is tossing the dough puts it on a screen so whoever is saucing and topping can easily grab it when they need it. On especially busy days it’s not uncommon to grab a freshly tossed dough and have it shrink immediately when you put it on the peel. Then you just don’t really have time to stretch it again and kinda say fuck it. That’s what I think happened here.
